 t = np.arange(N)/sr

    hp[i] = y
    prev_y = y
    prev_x = x

hato = np.tanh(hp*env*1.7)
write_wav('samples/hato.wav', hato)

def single_cycle(wave_fn, length=256):

    # normalize

write_wav('samples/bass_cycle.wav', bass_cycle)

# Pulse lead: 25% duty pulse
pulse_cycle = single_cycle(lambda x: (x % 1.0) < 0.25, 256)
pulse_cycle = (pulse_cycle*2-1)  # boolean to -1..1
write_wav('samples/pulse25_cycle.wav', pulse_cycle)

# Saw lead: simple saw
saw_cycle = single_cycle(lambda x: (2*(x - np.floor(x+0.5))), 256)
write_wav('samples/saw_cycle.wav', saw_cycle)
